I understand the situation.
Sorry. I just
couldn't say no.
I'm sorry.
I simply
couldn't refuse.
Still, those Guardians
have put some thought into this.
In other words,
they're testing
our resolve, right?
When you put it like that,
it kind of annoys me.
On the other hand,
this is an excellent chance
to earn their trust.
Hey, Teach. They said
they weren't going there
to fight, right?
Yeah. Of that much,
I'm certain.
Yes. I'm
sure of that.
Then the answer's simple.
One of the three laws
of Kyle's pirate family!
Whatever the challenge,
stand up and face it!
Then...?
Yeah, let's take them up
on their offer.
I see.
I understand the situation.
Sorry. I just
couldn't say no.
I'm sorry.
I simply
couldn't refuse.
You're way too
softhearted...
It's your own fault
for agreeing so readily.
There is a limit
to being a pushover!
That's no reason to...!
Now, now. It's too late
to turn them down,
so what else can we do?
Hey, Teach. They said
they weren't going there
to fight, right?
Yeah. Of that much,
I'm certain.
Yes. I'm
sure of that.
We'll simply have to
pin our hopes on that.
I guess all we can do
is see what happens.
Anyway...
Putting that aside,
what were they like!?
The settlements, I mean!
Yeah! I've been
wanting to hear
about that too!
Then why didn't
you all just
come along?
Then why didn't
you all come
with me?
Hahaha! Well,
you do have
a point...
Oh, come on!
Don't be stingy.
Tell us already!
